Another Russian command post near Velyka Novosilka was also struck. Russian losses and the extent of damage are being assessed. #Ukraine

The facility is critical for supplying fuel to Russian forces and supporting the defense industry. It has repeatedly been targeted by Ukrainian drones. #Ukraine

items.title: Russia struck Kyiv with ballistic missiles overnight, killing 2 people and injuring at least 10, Ukrainian authorities said. Damage to civilian infrastructure was reported at more than 16 locations across five districts. Residential buildings, warehouses, garages and an educational facility were among the sites damaged, with fires reported at several locations. Earlier, emergency services said 13 people had been rescued as crews worked across the capital. #Ukraine
items.summary:
Russia struck Kyiv with ballistic missiles overnight, killing 2 people and injuring at least 10, Ukrainian authorities said. Damage to civilian infrastructure was reported at more than 16 locations across five districts. Residential buildings, warehouses, garages and an educational facility were among the sites damaged, with fires reported at several locations. Earlier, emergency services said 13 people had been rescued as crews worked across the capital. #Ukraine
NOELREPORTS 🇪🇺 🇺🇦 (@NOELreports)
Ukraine's Air Force reported on the massive overnight attack, mainly focussed on Kyiv.
Shot down:
142/166 attack drones of various types
31/32 Kh-101/Iskander-K cruise missiles
2/? Iskander-M/KN-23/S-400/P-800 Oniks ballistic and hypersonic missiles
Hits by missiles and attack drones were recorded at 29 locations, and debris from downed targets fell in 9 locations. #Ukraine
